title: FrameworkDirective
description: Framework base Archetype for Directive — the governance intent half of the DNA grammar. Inherits gsm/Directive through the top-level $ref and composes the catalogue-wide FrameworkAscription facet through allOf. Every non-Archetype Directive statement distributed by this repository MUST be typed by this Archetype or one of its descendants, never directly by gsm/Directive, which carries no framework membership vocabulary. Source: gsm-frameworks (framework foundation).
